limitations: Tool versions were captured after the blocker observation from the same host and session; the session event schema did not persist a separate version snapshot per command.
The Copilot CLI shell tool retained a combined result stream. The importer preserves that stream exactly after sanitization and explicitly marks stdout and stderr as not separately recoverable.
Secrets, account emails, subscription identifiers, GUIDs, service and pairing keys, tokens, and PSKs are redacted before evidence is written.
